name: Zenith Weapon Master
name_jp: 究極ウェポンマスター
effects: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Holy/Ice/Fire, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Firion] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Holy/Ice/Fire, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Firion] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Firion
description.text: Increases [Ice/Fire/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire, Ice or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Firion after using a Fire, Ice or Holy ability, (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Firion
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 2], [Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
